summary: Phase 3 Marketing Core OS completed (human approval): brand, audiences, goals, content pillars, campaigns, content workflow, calendar, media library, dashboard and activity; tenant-isolated, permission-checked, audited, Arabic RTL and English LTR. All checks passed locally and in CI run 37834859497, Docker included.
breaking_changes: The workspace home page is now the marketing dashboard, and the shell navigation lists the Marketing Core sections the role may open.
risks: Deferred (accepted for Phase 3): media uploads have no per-user throttling; a workspace quota of 500 images of at most 10 MiB applies. To be evaluated with Production/Growth hardening.
Accepted: images are served as uploaded (no re-encoding or EXIF stripping) under nosniff and a sandboxing CSP.
Deferred by design: SCHEDULED is a planning state only; nothing is published automatically until publishing infrastructure and social integrations exist.
Accepted: missing records inside a workspace render a soft 404 (HTTP 200 with the not-found page) because workspace pages stream a loading state.
Accepted: if deleting a stored media object fails after the database commit, the object is orphaned (logged, unreachable); cleanup belongs to production hardening.
recommended_next_action: Phase 3 is complete. Phase 4 starts only with an explicit human instruction.
